title: CORE DataStructure
description: A CORE DataStructure: a named, versioned grouping of Elements. A DataStructure is a stored artifact (not a View) — it records which Elements belong together (e.g. all entities of one imported JSON Schema document). It carries no embedded content of its own; its members are referenced by URN and resolved on read.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataStructure.

elementRefs.description: URNs of the Elements grouped by this DataStructure.
